{{Quote|He's a total stranger.  There. I had to, or else I’ll have an aneurysm trying to stifle the urge to punch him out when he finally bothers to show up.|Jaina Solo, expressing frustration about her brother's behavior|<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref>}}
An '''aneurysm''' was a circulatory condition. Shortly after killing [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] gave the excuse that he was away on "[[Galactic Alliance Guard|GAG]] business" when refusing to make contact with his family.  This particularly upset his sister [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina]], leading her to tell [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] that Jacen was a stranger to her now, and she had to say it or she would have an aneurysm trying to keep from punching him out the next time she saw him.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
